claim_discipline.allowed: Method 2 improves structural validity / stability / repricing under the tested synthetic protocol (if supported); Method 2 improves parameter recovery on some metrics (if supported).
forbidden: Double Heston parameters are uniquely recovered
low repricing error proves correct parameters

evaluation_order.1: train all neural seeds for both models (no test metrics computed)
evaluation_order.3: run traditional calibration on the test split
evaluation_order.4: evaluate all methods on the untouched 1250-surface test split
evaluation_order.5: produce one unified comparison table and per-family reports

hyperparameter_policy.configuration_provenance: pre-existing implemented defaults (ann_baseline.yaml / pinn_baseline.yaml), not tuned on any split of the final dataset
hyperparameter_policy.selection_data: validation only (early stopping and best checkpoint)
hyperparameter_policy.smoke_runs: pipeline validation only; no scientific tuning from smoke metrics

feature_block_definitions.carries: 20 per-slot carries passed to the pricer in the dividend-yield slot (generation identity carry = rate + carry_offset; rank-constant within final-dataset surfaces).
feature_block_definitions.mask: 20 booleans encoded 1.0/0.0 in canonical slot order.
feature_block_definitions.maturities_years: 20 per-slot actual times to maturity in years (dte/365).
feature_block_definitions.prices_masked: 20 spot-normalized prices in canonical slot order; masked slots carry exactly 0.0 (MASKED_PRICE_PLACEHOLDER); synthetic surfaces are complete by construction (all masks true).
feature_block_definitions.rates: 20 per-slot risk-free rates (rank-constant within final-dataset surfaces).

input_representation.target_standardization: Train-split-fitted per-parameter mean/std (TargetStandardizer), fit once per training run on train rows only; identical fitted statistics used by both neural methods' parameter supervision.

constraint_validity: fraction of predicted vectors satisfying validate_parameters (all structural constraints)
per-constraint violation rates (positivity, ordering, per-factor Feller, correlation disk)

identifiability_aware.repricing-tolerance-conditioned paramete: success rates at normalized-price RMSE <= 1.0e-4 and <= 1.0e-3

identifiability_aware: explicit reporting of near-equivalent repricing with materially different parameters (no equivalence of repricing success and truth recovery)
parameter_recovery: per-parameter range-scaled error (scaled by train-split parameter range)

parameter_recovery.factorwise aggregate errors where scient: v0_total = v0_slow + v0_fast; theta_total = theta_slow + theta_fast; per-factor half-life ln(2)/kappa

parameter_recovery: factor_swap_confusion_rate (prediction closer to factor-swapped truth than to truth)

repricing.engine: production pricer node_count 64 on predicted representatives

runtime: neural per-surface amortized inference milliseconds (full test split, one batch, eval mode, no grad, CPU)
traditional per-surface calibration wall seconds (all three starts included)
neural training wall time reported separately per run

stability.neural: cross-seed standard deviation of every headline test metric; mean per-surface cross-seed prediction dispersion per parameter

stability.traditional: per-surface multi-start dispersion of predicted parameters; per-surface start disagreement rate

stability: constraint validity rate per seed / per start

model2_constraint_repricing_informed.block: LayerNorm + activation + dropout, residual when widths match
model2_constraint_repricing_informed.loss_formula: total = parameter_loss_weight * MSE(standardized(predicted_params), standardized(true_params)) + repricing_loss_weight * masked_MSE(repriced_normalized_prices, observed_normalized_prices)

repricing_term.prices: spot-normalized, masked slots excluded by the same mask
repricing_term.vectorization: batch-vectorized evaluation of the identical formulation (numerics pinned by equivalence tests vs the existing loop implementation and vs the production pricer); a feasibility-required implementation repair documented in the pre-training audit, not a scientific change.

output.model1_head: unconstrained ten-vector interpreted in standardized-target space
output.model2_head: raw ten-vector mapped by DoubleHestonConstraintMap: strict positivity (softplus + 1e-6), kappa_fast = kappa_slow + softplus (strict ordering), sigma_f <= sqrt(2*kappa*theta)*0.995 per factor, joint correlation disk radius <= 0.995 (polar map); outputs are physical parameters.

output_protection.large_artifacts_policy: *.pt checkpoints stay untracked (repo .gitignore); commit training histories, summaries, metrics, and hashes

protocol.method2_description: CONSTRAINT-INFORMED + DIFFERENTIABLE-REPRICING-INFORMED inverse model. NOT a PDE-informed PINN; no learned forward-PDE residual is used. Archive-2 PDE behavior is not imported (Issue #20 quarantine active).
protocol.name: R2_PRIMARY_DOUBLE_HESTON_COMPARISON
protocol.primary_question_disclaimer: Practical non-identifiability is a retained research finding. Repricing quality is NEVER treated as equivalent to unique parameter recovery. No claim of unique identifiability is permitted from this comparison.
protocol.scientific_question: Given an inherently ill-conditioned Double Heston inverse problem, does a constraint + differentiable-repricing-informed inverse network produce more stable, structurally valid, and useful parameter representatives than traditional numerical calibration and an ordinary ANN inverse model?

seeds.multi_seed_aggregation: per-seed rows plus cross-seed mean and standard deviation
seeds.provenance: first three of the pre-existing evaluation.repeated_seeds list in configs/ann_baseline.yaml
seeds.rule: all seeds trained, all seeds retained and reported; no seed discarded or cherry-picked

traditional_calibration.failure_handling: every failed start is recorded; no silent reruns with new settings
traditional_calibration.objective: least_squares residuals (predicted - observed) / max(observed, 1.0) on DOLLAR prices (normalized price * spot)
traditional_calibration.parallelization: surface-level worker processes (implementation only; per-surface budget unchanged)
traditional_calibration.representative_selection_rule: per surface, the start with the lowest final objective (mean squared residual) among all recorded starts, regardless of optimizer success flag; ties broken by lower start_index; failures retained and reported.
traditional_calibration.runtime_note: pre-protocol timing on train-split surfaces measured 124-170 s per surface at these exact settings (see pre-training audit); frozen as-is.

starts.disclosure: one start is a DISCLOSED truth-informed perturbation (unconstrained truth coordinate + N(0, 0.35^2)); this favors the traditional baseline and is retained from the existing canonical module without change; per-start outcomes are retained and reported.
